_help: Joystick axis mapping for server.py (pygame). axis = pygame axis index, invert = flip sign. Throttle uses (1 - v) / 2 so the usual 'forward = -1' throttle lever gives full power. Elevator: JSBSim + = nose down (push); most sticks give -1 when pushed forward, so invert = true. Restart server.py after editing.
